title: Dilating an integer multiplicity triple gives an integer multiplicity triple (parent step 3)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n: M Borel and countably n-rectifiable, θ : ℝ^P → ℕ measurable with θ > 0 on M and ∫⁻_{M∩K} θ dH^n < ∞ for every compact K, ξ a.e.-strongly measurable for H^n⌞M and, for H^n⌞M-a.e. x, a unit orientation (IsUnitOrientationOf) of some approximate tangent space Q of M at x). Let c > 0. Then there is an IMRep univ n triple R' with R'.carrier = {x : cx ∈ M}, R'.mult x = θ(cx) and R'.orient x = ξ(cx) for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.carrier = (fun x => c • x) ⁻¹' R.carrier ∧ (∀ x, R'.mult x = R.mult (c • x)) ∧ ∀ x, R'.orient x = R.orient (c • x)
